author: Alexander McKibbin
description:
Labour's latest plan to micro-manage school dinner menus is yet more displacement activity from a Government that has proved itself singularly unable to bring down the UK's £3.7 trillion debt, says Alexander McKibbin.

The post The Government Should Focus on Cutting the Deficit, Not Policing Apple Crumble appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: The Government Should Focus on Cutting the Deficit, Not Policing Apple Crumble

author: Will Jones
description:
Labour's online censorship plan to force social media companies to promote the BBC and other 'trustworthy' news outlets and demote the rest is not based on evidence, according to a new report by David Rose for the FSU.

The post Labour’s Pro-BBC Censorship Push is Not Based on Evidence appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Labour’s Pro-BBC Censorship Push is Not Based on Evidence

author: Mary Gilleece
description:
Bunking off school used to be called truancy, but now 'Emotional Based School Avoidance', or EBSA, has joined the ever-growing list of supposed mental health conditions afflicting the nation's youth, says Mary Gilleece.

The post Truancy is Now a Mental Health Condition appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Truancy is Now a Mental Health Condition

author: Will Jones
description:
Labour is to make lentils and chickpeas compulsory in school dinners and ban traditional fish and chips and other fried food in its latest killjoy move as headteachers warn the pricey health drive will lead staffing cuts.

The post Labour to Make Lentils Compulsory in School Dinners – and Ban Fish and Chips appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Labour to Make Lentils Compulsory in School Dinners – and Ban Fish and Chips

author: Georg Dreyman
description:
From glowing vasectomy profiles to rainbow iconography, mainstream culture is waging quiet war on human fecundity. Is Huxley's sterile dystopia already here, asks Georg Dreyman.

The post The Cult of Sterility: How Modern Culture Declared War on Human Fecundity appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: The Cult of Sterility: How Modern Culture Declared War on Human Fecundity

author: Richard Eldred
description:
The National Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Children has quietly scrapped its long-standing requirement that adults supervising children in changing rooms must be the same sex as the pupils.

The post Fury as NSPCC Say Male Teachers Can Supervise Girls in Changing Rooms appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Fury as NSPCC Say Male Teachers Can Supervise Girls in Changing Rooms

author: Ben Pile
description:
Two billionaires have given £72 million to Reform and the establishment has cried foul. Yet Christopher Hohn's charitable foundation pumps £175 million a year into NGOs to spew out pro-Green propaganda, says Ben Pile.

The post Yes, Reform Has Just Received £72 million Over a Three-Year Period. But Christopher Hohn’s Foundation Pumps £175 Million a Year in to the Green Blob appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Yes, Reform Has Just Received £72 million Over a Three-Year Period. But Christopher Hohn’s Foundation Pumps £175 Million a Year in to the Green Blob

author: Richard Eldred
description:
A summary of the most interesting stories in the past 24 hours that challenge the prevailing orthodoxy about the 'climate emergency', public health 'crises' and the supposed moral defects of Western civilisation.

The post News Round-Up appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: News Round-Up
